title: Me and you
goal: say I, you, he, she, it and we, say yes or no, and say please and thank you.

title: Who I am
goal: say your name and where you are from.
wants: phrase: ich heiße = my name is
phrase: Wie heißt du? = what's your name?
phrase: freut mich = nice to meet you

title: Hello, how are you?
goal: say hello and goodbye, ask how someone is and say how you are.
wants: phrase: Wie geht's? = how are you?
phrase: mir geht's gut = I'm fine
phrase: und dir? = and you? (how are you)

title: What I want and have
goal: say what you would like and what you have.
wants: möchten: he / she would like (er möchte)

title: My people
goal: talk about the people in your life.

title: A coffee, please
goal: order a drink and say who you have.
wants: case: einen Bruder = I have [a] brother
case: den Mann = I see [the] man
case: meinen Vater = I love [my] father
case: eine Schwester = I have [a] sister
case: ein Haus = I have [a] house
case: den Tee = I'm drinking [the] tea
case: das Wasser = I'm drinking [the] water
payoff: A coffee and a beer, please.
I have a brother and a sister.

title: Asking questions
goal: ask what, who, where, when, how and why.
wants: phrase: Wie bitte? = pardon? (I didn't catch that)

title: When I don't understand
goal: say you don't understand or don't know, and ask how to say something.
wants: phrase: Sprechen Sie Englisch? = do you speak English? (polite)
phrase: noch einmal, bitte = once more, please
phrase: Wie sagt man … auf Deutsch? = how do you say … in German?
case: keinen Bruder = I have [no] brother
case: keine Schwester = I have [no] sister

title: Can you help me?
goal: ask for help and say what you can, must and need.

title: Out and about
goal: speak politely to strangers and ask where things are.
wants: können: to be able to (Sie können)
phrase: es gibt = there is, there are
phrase: Wo ist die Toilette? = where is the toilet?
payoff: Excuse me, where is the hotel?
Excuse me, can you help me? (polite)

title: Where I'm going
goal: say where you are going and when.
wants: nach: to (a city, a country, home)

title: What I do
goal: say where you live and work and what you do in a day.
payoff: I live in Berlin and work here.

title: What I like
goal: say what you like, what you like doing and what you want.
wants: case: die Musik = I like [the] music
case: ein Bier = I want [a] beer

title: How I feel
goal: say how you feel: hungry, cold, scared, sad or sick.

title: People I love
goal: tell someone you love and miss them and that you'll call.
wants: phrase: bis später = see you later
case: meine Mutter = I love [my] mother
case: meinen Bruder = I miss [my] brother

title: Buying things
goal: count to five, ask what something costs and pay.
wants: phrase: Was kostet das? = how much is it?

title: With friends
goal: say who you are with and whose place you are at.
wants: case: mit einem Freund = with [a] friend
case: mit meiner Mutter = with [my] mother
case: mit dem Kind = with [the] child
case: mit der Frau = with [the] woman
case: mit meinem Vater = with [my] father
case: mit dem Mann = with [the] man
case: mit einer Frau = with [a] woman
case: mit einem Kind = with [a] child
case: mit den Kindern = with [the] children

title: Making plans
goal: invite someone along and say what will happen tonight and tomorrow.
wants: phrase: Kommst du mit? = are you coming along?
case: bei meinem Bruder = at [my] brother's
case: bei meiner Schwester = at [my] sister's
case: zu meiner Mutter = to [my] mother's
case: zu meinem Freund = to [my] friend's
case: mit meinen Freunden = with [my] friends
